{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Technical Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer",
  "description": "Golborn Services Limited is a GovTech company focused on accelerating digital transformation across Nigeria&#39;s public sector. We develop and deploy innovative technology solutions that improve institutional efficiency, strengthen public service delivery and enable data-driven decision-making.

As we expand our operations across federal and state governments, we are seeking an experienced and highly creative candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Technical Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer

Job Location: Abuja

About the role


	We are looking for an exceptional Technical Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer who can combine strategic thinking, business analysis, technology literacy and project coordination to support executive decision-making and organisational execution.
	The successful candidate will work directly with the CEO to coordinate strategic initiatives, monitor business performance, prepare executive-level reports and presentations, and ensure effective follow-through on key management decisions.
	You will serve as an important coordination point between the CEO and the company&#39;s commercial, technical, finance and corporate services functions.
	This is not a conventional administrative or personal assistant role. It requires a professional who can independently analyse complex business issues, conduct research, develop strategic recommendations and coordinate high-priority initiatives.
	We are particularly interested in candidates with backgrounds in management consulting, technology consulting, corporate strategy, business analysis, project management or executive advisory.


Key responsibilities
Strategic planning and executive support:


	Support the CEO in developing, communicating and executing the company&#39;s strategic priorities.
	Translate strategic objectives into actionable implementation plans, milestones and performance indicators.
	Conduct research and analysis to support executive decision-making.
	Prepare strategic briefs, executive presentations, business cases and decision papers.
	Coordinate strategic planning sessions, executive workshops and management reviews.
	Maintain a structured register of the CEO&#39;s strategic priorities, decisions and assigned actions.
	Monitor the implementation of strategic initiatives and identify execution risks, delays and dependencies.


Business analysis and performance monitoring:


	Consolidate and analyse business performance reports from Commercial, Technology, Finance and Corporate Services.
	Develop executive dashboards, management reporting templates and performance scorecards.
	Monitor departmental performance against approved business objectives and identify operational gaps.
	Prepare periodic business performance summaries and executive management reports.
	Conduct business analysis, feasibility assessments and financial reviews to support strategic decisions.
	Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend opportunities for improvement.
	Support management in evaluating business performance, resource allocation and organisational effectiveness.


Technology and digital transformation:


	Conduct research on emerging GovTech trends, digital public infrastructure, enterprise technology and public-sector digital transformation opportunities.
	Support the CEO in evaluating strategic technology initiatives, product opportunities and potential technology partnerships.
	Work closely with the CTO and technical teams to monitor strategic technology projects and product development milestones.
	Translate complex technical information into clear executive-level briefs and presentations.
	Support the preparation of technology concept papers, solution briefs and presentations for government and institutional stakeholders.
	Research relevant government digital transformation programmes, technology policies and emerging market opportunities.
	Monitor the progress of strategic technology initiatives and highlight issues requiring executive attention.


Strategic project coordination and execution:


	Coordinate high-priority projects and special assignments delegated by the CEO.
	Develop project implementation plans, milestone trackers, action registers and progress reports.
	Monitor the execution of strategic initiatives across departments.
	Follow up with responsible teams to ensure timely completion of agreed deliverables.
	Identify project risks, cross-functional dependencies and execution bottlenecks.
	Facilitate collaboration between departmental heads on initiatives requiring executive coordination.
	Prepare consolidated project status reports and escalate critical issues to the CEO.
	Support the implementation of corrective actions and operational improvement initiatives.


Executive stakeholder and partnership coordination:


	Support the CEO in coordinating relationships with strategic partners, government institutions, technology partners and other key stakeholders.
	Conduct background research and prepare briefing notes ahead of high-level executive engagements.
	Develop presentations, executive summaries and supporting materials for strategic meetings.
	Coordinate internal preparation for partnership discussions and institutional engagements.
	Document strategic meeting outcomes, agreed commitments and assigned responsibilities.
	Follow up with relevant departments to ensure timely implementation of agreed actions.
	Support the coordination and monitoring of strategic partnerships and joint initiatives.


Corporate governance and executive reporting:


	Support the preparation of board presentations, management reports and executive performance updates.
	Coordinate the collection and consolidation of information required for management and board-level reviews.
	Track the implementation of relevant management and board decisions.
	Maintain accurate records of strategic decisions, assigned responsibilities and implementation deadlines.
	Work with departmental heads to ensure executive reports are accurate, timely and complete.
	Handle sensitive commercial, operational and strategic information with appropriate confidentiality and discretion.


Executive office coordination:


	Manage the CEO&#39;s strategic action register and monitor progress on delegated assignments.
	Coordinate information flow between the CEO and departmental heads.
	Support the prioritisation of matters requiring executive attention.
	Prepare agendas, briefing materials and action summaries for key management meetings.
	Ensure management decisions and commitments are documented and tracked.
	Undertake special projects and strategic assignments as directed by the CEO.


What success looks like in this role
You will be expected to:


	Provide timely, accurate and insightful analysis that supports executive decision-making.
	Ensure strategic initiatives and high-priority assignments are effectively coordinated and monitored.
	Produce high-quality executive briefs, management reports, presentations and decision- support materials.
	Improve visibility over organisational performance through structured dashboards and reporting.
	Facilitate effective collaboration between the CEO and departmental heads.
	Ensure timely follow-through on executive decisions, strategic commitments and assigned actions.
	Identify operational risks, execution gaps and opportunities for organisational improvement.


Essential requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline.
	Minimum of five years&#39; relevant professional experience in strategy, business analysis, technology consulting, project management, executive advisory or a related field.
	Demonstrated ability to analyse complex business and technical information and develop actionable recommendations.
	Experience supporting senior executives or coordinating cross-functional business initiatives.
	Strong understanding of technology businesses, enterprise technology solutions or digital transformation.
	Excellent research, analytical, business writing and presentation skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
	Strong project coordination, stakeholder management and organisational skills.
	Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
	Excellent professional judgement and the ability to handle confidential information.


Desirable qualifications and experience:


	MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.
	Experience in management consulting, technology consulting, corporate strategy or a CEO&#39;s office.
	Professional certification in project management, business analysis or a related discipline.
	Familiarity with GovTech, digital public infrastructure and public-sector digital transformation.
	Experience developing executive dashboards, financial models and board-level presentations.
	Proficiency in business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
	Experience coordinating strategic partnerships or high-priority organisational initiatives.


Salary
N800,000 per month.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: info@golborn.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

  "description": "Beckley Consulting Ltd is a company with special focus on development and growth of micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in Nigeria. We also provide and manage out-sourced labour, temporary or permanent, semi-skilled or skilled, according to specific needs of our clients and ensure that statutory deductions and labour laws are complied with. The company is determined to make a difference in all its assignments through personal service delivered with a strong commitment to integrity and professional excellence. Our key objective is to add value in every area of collaboration with our clients. Beckley Consulting Limited (BCL) has its registered office in Lagos. The Company has assembled a team of experienced and energetic professionals and partners who are experts in various fields to provide effective, reliable and cutting edge services to meet and exceed the expectations of our clients. The management and staff of the Company have the requisite expertise and experience to deliver value added solutions to meet the needs of clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Positin: Social Media Officer
Job Location: Isolo, Lagos (Applicants must reside within close proximity)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Hybrid)

Job Summary


	We are seeking a creative, proactive, and results-driven Social Media Officer to manage our digital presence across multiple social media platforms.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating engaging content, growing our online community, increasing brand visibility, and supporting the company&#39;s marketing and communication objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop, create, and schedule engaging content across social media platforms.
	Manage the company&#39;s social media accounts and respond to comments, messages, and inquiries promptly.
	Plan and execute social media campaigns to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
	Monitor social media trends and recommend innovative strategies to improve online presence.
	Create basic graphics, videos, and other digital content for marketing campaigns.
	Track, analyse, and report on social media performance using relevant analytics tools.
	Collaborate with internal teams to promote company activities, products, and services.
	Ensure all content aligns with the company&#39;s brand identity and communication guidelines.
	Perform other related duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Marketing, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience managing social media accounts for a business or brand.
	Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X (Twitter).
	Proficiency in content creation tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar applications.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Knowledge of social media analytics and content performance reporting.
	Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently in a hybrid work environment.
	Applicants must reside within proximity to Isolo, Lagos.


Salary
N120,000 per month.&nbsp;

Method of Applictaion&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and portfolio (or links to social media pages they have managed) to: recruitment@beckleyconsulting.com using &ldquo;Social Media Officer&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Job Location: Lagos

	Revenue &amp; Quota Ownership: Own an individual annual target in USD across direct solution consulting, software license subscriptions, and managed services attach rates.
	Strategic Planning: Align products and services with client objectives, and drive revenue growth through collaboration.
	Pipeline Management: Build and maintain an active, high-velocity qualified pipeline of at least 3.5x annual quota across all accounts.
	C-Suite &amp; Executive Engagement: Establish and cultivate relationships with CxOs (CIOs, CFOs, CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Transformation) in banking, fintech, oil &amp; gas, telecom, public sectors, etc.
	Cross-Pillar Solution Selling: Drive complex deal structuring that combines Cloud &amp; AI pipelines, AI Business Solutions migrations , and Managed Cybersecurity.
	Co-Selling &amp; Ecosystem Leveraging: Maximize joint co-sell frameworks with our key OEM partner (specifically Microsoft Solutions Partner ecosystem) to secure partner funding, proof-of-concept (POC) credits, and executive sponsorship.
	CSAM &amp; Account Expansion Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAMs), Business Leads to drive post-implementation adoption, ensuring high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and cloud consumption utilization.


Requirements

	Education: Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, or a related quantitative field. An MBA or relevant Master&rsquo;s Degree is preferred.


Years of Experience:


	9+ years of direct B2B enterprise technology sales experience, with a proven track record of selling enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or digital transformation consulting services.
	6+ years specifically managing large-scale enterprise deals ($500k to $2M+ Total Contract Value) within the African technology landscape (Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Zambia, etc.).


Technical &amp; Domain Expertise:


	Deep commercial understanding of MS cloud ecosystems (Microsoft Azure), Enterprise ERP / CRM platforms (Dynamics 365), Data Analytics/AI frameworks, and Enterprise Security (Identity Governance, MDR, Zero-Trust Architecture).
	Familiarity with Microsoft co-selling programs, CSP licensing models, and enterprise software procurement cycles.
	Track Record: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas above $10M+ USD in software or IT solution services.


Ideal Candidate Profile &amp; Key Competencies:


	Strategic Deal Structurer: Ability to navigate complex corporate procurement processes, build compelling financial business cases (ROI/TCO analysis), and negotiate directly with CFOs and Procurement Boards.
	Consultative Challenger: Possesses a deep business acumen to diagnose client operational bottlenecks and translate complex cloud/AI technology into measurable business outcomes.
	Ecosystem Navigator: Skilled at leveraging external partner networks (OEM sales reps, distributors, business unit leaders) to accelerate sales cycles and unlock co-funding.
	Resilient &amp; Adaptable: Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth technology environments and navigate regional macroeconomic shifts (currency devaluation, inflation) with structured hedging strategies.
	Relentless Pipeline Builder: Disciplined approach to account-based prospecting, cold outbound engagement, and executive networking.

Key Account Manager - Cloud, AI & Security Solutions Job at Infinion Technologies




        
    

        
        At Infinion Technologies, we design productivity boosting solutions aimed at delivering business value and making infrastructure and applications available to enterprises. We are a technology and business solutions Company established with the objective of providing world class solutions to Enterprise Businesses. We seek to offer individuals and organizations sublime services to improve operational efficiency. As a certified Microsoft Partner, we never lose sight of the role we play in helping businesses automate their processes and solve their problems in the local and international community.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Key Account Manager - Cloud, AI & Security Solutions
     

            
    



Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables


	Revenue & Quota Ownership: Own an individual annual target in USD across direct solution consulting, software license subscriptions, and managed services attach rates.
	Strategic Planning: Align products and services with client objectives, and drive revenue growth through collaboration.
	Pipeline Management: Build and maintain an active, high-velocity qualified pipeline of at least 3.5x annual quota across all accounts.
	C-Suite & Executive Engagement: Establish and cultivate relationships with CxOs (CIOs, CFOs, CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Transformation) in banking, fintech, oil & gas, telecom, public sectors, etc.
	Cross-Pillar Solution Selling: Drive complex deal structuring that combines Cloud & AI pipelines, AI Business Solutions migrations , and Managed Cybersecurity.
	Co-Selling & Ecosystem Leveraging: Maximize joint co-sell frameworks with our key OEM partner (specifically Microsoft Solutions Partner ecosystem) to secure partner funding, proof-of-concept (POC) credits, and executive sponsorship.
	CSAM & Account Expansion Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAMs), Business Leads to drive post-implementation adoption, ensuring high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and cloud consumption utilization.


Requirements
Qualifications & Experience Requirements:


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, or a related quantitative field. An MBA or relevant Master’s Degree is preferred.


Years of Experience:


	9+ years of direct B2B enterprise technology sales experience, with a proven track record of selling enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or digital transformation consulting services.
	6+ years specifically managing large-scale enterprise deals ($500k to $2M+ Total Contract Value) within the African technology landscape (Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Zambia, etc.).


Technical & Domain Expertise:


	Deep commercial understanding of MS cloud ecosystems (Microsoft Azure), Enterprise ERP / CRM platforms (Dynamics 365), Data Analytics/AI frameworks, and Enterprise Security (Identity Governance, MDR, Zero-Trust Architecture).
	Familiarity with Microsoft co-selling programs, CSP licensing models, and enterprise software procurement cycles.
	Track Record: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas above $10M+ USD in software or IT solution services.


Ideal Candidate Profile & Key Competencies:


	Strategic Deal Structurer: Ability to navigate complex corporate procurement processes, build compelling financial business cases (ROI/TCO analysis), and negotiate directly with CFOs and Procurement Boards.
	Consultative Challenger: Possesses a deep business acumen to diagnose client operational bottlenecks and translate complex cloud/AI technology into measurable business outcomes.
	Ecosystem Navigator: Skilled at leveraging external partner networks (OEM sales reps, distributors, business unit leaders) to accelerate sales cycles and unlock co-funding.
	Resilient & Adaptable: Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth technology environments and navigate regional macroeconomic shifts (currency devaluation, inflation) with structured hedging strategies.
	Relentless Pipeline Builder: Disciplined approach to account-based prospecting, cold outbound engagement, and executive networking.
